method.layer1: study chain (physical IAM, Marion diffuse IAM, SAPM open-rack cell temperature, PVWatts DC gamma=-0.35%/K, no loss chain) driven by PVGIS Gb(i)/Gd(i)/Gr(i)/T2m/WS10m 2005-2020 vs PVGIS P with system loss 0
method.layer2: study TMY chain (Hay-Davies from GHI/DNI/DHI, no loss chain) vs PVGIS 2005-2020 monthly and annual means
method.normalisation: NMBE and NRMSE normalised by the mean of the PVGIS series over the compared samples (daylight hours for hourly, all months for monthly)

criteria.p90: annual LOLP <= target in at least 15 of the 16 years
criteria.all: annual LOLP <= target in all 16 years
